issueSummary: The site has contact basics but needs clearer hero positioning, service packaging, and a specific inquiry path.
topFindings: Hero copy is brand-focused and does not quickly explain the bookkeeping outcome or buyer fit.
Services are not packaged into scannable paths, leaving prospects to infer what TLC can do.
The inquiry path is generic and lacks a reassuring next-step explanation.
preservedDesign: Preserved the simple Wix-builder feel, pale blue/white palette, top contact strip, right-aligned TLC brand block, large uppercase hero, centered sections, and contact/footer structure.
criticalCoverageStatus: All critical and high findings were addressed in the prototype with clearer hero copy, specific CTAs, service cards, next-step section, and light cleanup.
